column5: PIPE or GARDEN (the two plants with active daily workbooks). HDPE / PTMT / TANK have daily files registered but no monthly grid baseline yet — they are ingested as monthly-only until a monthly grid is added.

Friendly name only — used here for reference. The actual workbook is identified by its Google Drive file ID pinned in sources.py. When a new monthly file is created in Drive its file ID must be added to DAILY_SOURCES in sources.py.
Report-5 for Pipe/PTMT layout. Daily Report for Garden/HDPE/Tank layout. The engine tries both in that order and takes whichever tab exists.

Row label in the wide matrix. Must contain M/C-n (e.g. M/C-1) for Pipe or MACHINE-n (e.g. MACHINE-1) for Garden. Rows labelled TOTAL / PART-1 / PART-2 / %AGE are skipped automatically. The label must match the corresponding machine in the monthly grid — the join is on the numeric suffix only (M/C-3 matches PIPE M/C-3).

Column header in the wide matrix (repeated for each date). The engine auto-detects the date format. Both day-first (01-Apr-26) and month-first (Apr, 1) work. Leave future dates blank — blank or zero rows are skipped.
Actual run hours for that machine on that date. Sub-column header must contain RUN. Rows where both run_hours and output are 0 or blank are skipped (treated as non-production day).

Actual output in KG for that machine on that date. Sub-column header must contain OUTPUT. IMPORTANT for PIPE: the daily sheet records NET output (gross minus rejects). The monthly grid records GROSS. This causes a ~6.6% reconciliation gap for PIPE — this is expected and surfaced as an honest warning, not an error.
Rejection in KG for that machine on that date. Sub-column header must contain REJECT. Blank = 0. Rejection % is always recomputed (rejection ÷ output) — any stored % column in the sheet is ignored.

column1: Once all monthly and daily data are entered, the four-tier Data Confirmation engine will check:
Tier 1 — Completeness: are all expected machines present for all months?
Tier 2 — Internal reconciliation: does the sum of per-machine monthly rows match the grid TOTAL row? Does daily output reconcile with monthly (within 5% tolerance for PIPE due to net-vs-gross)?
Tier 3 — Validity: no performance > 100%, no rejection > output
Tier 4 — Plausibility: any month with < 50% utilisation is flagged for review
Navigate to /confirmation in the dashboard to see the full audit report after data entry.
